d: Malaysia is tightening checks at its borders, with more than 400,000 citizens facing restrictions on overseas travel since 2024. Unpaid taxes, student loans, bankruptcy cases and other outstanding liabilities can prevent Malaysians from leaving the country. But the scrutiny does not stop there. Between January and October this year, Malaysia issued more than 41,600 notices refusing entry to foreign travellers, an average of nearly 140 people a day.
